literal: If one fully severs desire, the unfailing state will come by the way oneself desires.
translation: If one completely severs desire, an imperishable state will come to them in the very way they desire.
modern: ஆசையை முழுமையாக அழித்துவிட்டால், ஒருவன் விரும்புகின்ற வழியிலேயே அவனுக்கு அழியாத நன்னிலை வந்து சேரும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the ultimate reward of eradicating desire. The word 'அவா' means desire or craving, and 'ஆற்ற அறுப்பின்' emphasizes cutting it off completely without any residue. When a person achieves this, 'தவா வினை'—an unfailing or imperishable state of being—is attained. Ironically, by giving up all desires, the supreme state comes to the person exactly in the manner they would wish ('தான் வேண்டும் ஆற்றான்').
